movelist.name: Sweet Scent
movelist.effect: Targets hit by Sweet Scent gain a -2 Penalty to Evasion. (Total Evasion may not be lowered to a negative value. )

movelist.name: Draining Kiss
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Sweet Kiss
movelist.effect: The target becomes Confused. On miss, the target suffers a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls for one full round.

movelist.name: Aromatherapy
movelist.effect: All allies in the burst are cured of one status condition of their choice.

movelist.name: Aromatic Mist
movelist.effect: All allies in Aromatic Mist’s area of effect have their Special Defense raised 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Sweet Veil
abilities.effect: The user and allies within 3 meters are immune to Sleep. Defensive.

abilities.name: Aroma Veil
abilities.effect: The user and all adjacent Pokémon and Trainers cannot become Confused, Enraged, or Suppressed. Defensive.
